title: [LOGGED OUT] Pinch zoom is allowed on phones
reason: Viewport meta contains maximum-scale=1, which blocks pinch zoom

steps.text: Start a new browser session with no saved cookies or cache. Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Home page loaded, title "LUDUS - Merge Battle Arena PvP Web Shop", cookie banner shown

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
Read the content of the meta name="viewport" tag with execute_script and write it in "saw".
Does the viewport tag allow zoom (it does not contain "maximum-scale=1" or "user-scalable=no")?
steps.saw: Content contains "maximum-scale=1" (no user-scalable=no). maximum-scale=1 prevents pinch zoom on iOS/Android
